verdict.justification: The project aims to develop a serious game for supporting learning in the subject 'Fundamentals of Imperative Programming' at Universidad del Valle sede Tuluá. The project is designed to address the recurring difficulties faced by students in this subject, which are due to both the inherent complexity of the content and the limited programming bases they enter the course with. The project focuses on three areas of greater complexity: recursion, vectors and matrices, and graphical interface. These topics were selected for addressing in the development of the project. For the implementation of the project, the SUM methodology in video games was adopted, structured in the phases of Concept, Planning, Elaboration, Beta, and Closure. Additionally, a heuristic evaluation was carried out with the aim of conducting usability tests, allowing valuable feedback to be obtained about students' opinions on the developed game.
